items.a: Cross browser testing checks that a website works and looks right in different browsers, browser versions, operating systems and devices.

items.q: How many browsers does TestMu AI support?
items.a: TestMu AI offers 3,000+ browser and OS combinations, including Chrome, Firefox, Edge, Safari and Opera, with legacy and beta versions.

items.q: Can I test Safari without a Mac?
items.a: Yes. Open Safari on macOS in your browser from any operating system.

items.q: Can I test a site on localhost?
items.a: Yes. The tunnel lets cloud browsers reach localhost and staging builds.
Yes. The live testing free plan gives 1 parallel test with limited sessions renewed every month. Virtual Live starts at $15 per month, billed annually.
